p.i: iuibus [?] lupos tecum Vitricibus armis gimus, in media nobis quum morte relinquas, npe etiam nobis Vere post funera Viuis, Viues, donec cælorum regia tecum ici excipiat functos certamine cunctos.

main_text.head: ASPARIS PEVCERI MEMORIÆ, Casparis illius Peuceri, clariss. virtutibus omnibus viri, F. magni illius Philippi Melanchthonis N.

p.i: Euceros habuit nuper Germania binos, Vnum patrem, natum alterum:
Qnum isto patrem nato, natumque parentem: Vtrumque patriæ decus:
Horum seruatum nobis diuinitus illum, Amant boni, timent mali.
Hunc Vero nimis, ah, festina morte peremptum Cum patre nunc deflent boni.
Tu Peucer is quam dura hac fata duobus Fruì Vetant, Germania,
Sapiis, hunc ferua, quo salvo dives habebis Quod orbis invideat tibi.

page.notes: Top lines are cut at the left edge; several words are doubtful because of the long s and the mixed italic/roman setting. The first line's opening word is partly obscured by a stain. The line "Euceros" and the "Qnum"/"Qued" initials are uncertain; a dark mark sits near the left margin, not text. Right-margin ornaments and specks are not printed text.
